On Thu, 8 Apr, 2021, 6:56 pm Edward Rigdon, <edward...@gmail.com> wrote:
By default, lavaan allows but warns of negative variance or residual variances. You can impose inequality constraints to ensure nonnegative variances.
'
ETA =~ y1 + y2
y1 ~~ a*y1           # a is a label for the residual variance of y1
y2 ~~ b*y2
a > 0
b > 0
'

On Thu, Apr 8, 2021 at 3:52 AM fay ta <fay...@gmail.com> wrote:
Lavaan uses nlminb optimizer, since no constrained optimization is considered in the general cases (such as nlminb.constr), how is it ensured that the estimations of error variances will be non-negative?
